Q25001. Railway ALP / SSC Reasoning – What is the next number in the series: 7, 10, 13, 16, ?
    A. 19
    B. 22
    C. 17
    D. 38

Answer: 19
Solution: This sequence has a common difference of 3. Each term increases by 3 from the previous term, so after 16, the next term is 19.

Q29001. IBPS/SSC Quant – Calculate the simple interest on Rs. 3000 at 5% per annum for 1 years.
    A. 150.0
    B. 300.0
    C. 90.0
    D. 300.0

Answer: 150.0
Solution: Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100 = (3000 × 5 × 1)/100 = 150.0.

    B. 8722.8
    C. 8512.8
    D. 17145.6

Answer: 8572.8
Solution: Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100 = (107160 × 8 × 1)/100 = 8572.8.
